links.outcome: Response consistency across repeated trials of OITE questions
links.effect: Fully consistent responses 88% for GPT-5 and 84% for Gemini; all inconsistent outputs occurred in image-containing questions.
links.quote: Consistency testing showed high reproducibility (fully consistent responses: 88% for GPT-5 and 84% for Gemini), with all inconsistent outputs occurring in image-containing questions.

links.outcome: Explanation validity and reasoning errors despite high exam accuracy
links.effect: Incorrect or partially correct explanations accompanied 45.4% of GPT-5 and 41.7% of Gemini responses despite accuracy of 76.0% and 81.1%, exceeding PGY-5 benchmarks.
links.quote: Incorrect or partially correct explanations accompanied 45.4% of GPT-5 and 41.7% of Gemini responses.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and reasoning accuracy of multimodal LLMs (GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro) on orthopaedic examination questions without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
